utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday at the community center works for me — I’m happy to help. Let me know if you want me to bring any tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and making a list of the tools and spare parts we already have. If anything’s missing, I’ll let you know before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — thanks, Cleo. Just let me know what’s still needed, and I’ll bring whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for checking in, Uli — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center on Maple Street. I’ll send the full details now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I’ve got it — Sunday at the community center on Maple Street, and I’ll help if I can be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Uli — thanks for confirming. If you can make it Sunday at the community center on Maple Street, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s going pretty well, but we still need a hand sorting donations and checking what’s usable. If you’ve got those old tools, bringing them by would really help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s great to hear—sounds like sorting is the big need right now. I’ll ask around about old tools and see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That would be a huge help, thanks. If you can, bring them by this afternoon and I’ll show you where to start sorting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check around and bring anything broken I can find to the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Saturday morning works. I’m still checking what needs fixing, and I’ll let you know if I need that wrench or screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know. I’ll bring what I find to the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard a few more donations came in today, so I’m going to check what still needs to be covered while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, that’s helpful — I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll pass that along too. Let me know what’s still needed and I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll check in while I’m out and tell you what’s still needed. Sunday at the community center sounds good; I’ll keep that in mind too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can still drop off the fence hardware and porch light bulbs later. If there’s anything small and easy to fix, I’ll bring that by too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Bo—those sound like perfect easy fixes. Bring them by, and I’ll see what else we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll swing by with those later and see if I can grab one more small thing on the way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can check the list and see what’s still missing for the repair drive. Then we can sort through it together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly tools and a few extra hands, right? Thanks — I can help sort through the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that sounds right — I’ll take another look at the list and see what’s still missing. Thanks, Rey; we can sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can still help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to handle, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. Once you send the repair list, I can help fit things around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll send the repair list over soon. What time on Sunday should I plan for at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to sort out the logistics—what tools do we already have, and what are we still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got some basic hand tools covered, but I still need to confirm hammers, screwdrivers, tape, and a few extension cords. I’ll make a quick list and check what’s missing before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—that helps. Once you’ve got the list, send it my way and I’ll see what I can still track down before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive too—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks — I can help with that. What’s been fixed so far, and what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not totally up to speed yet—what’s been fixed so far, and what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Kira. Please send me the list of repairs and any timing details, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, I’ll send you the list of repairs and the timing details soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Kira. I’ll watch for the list and timing details, and then I’ll keep everything on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, I can pass it along — it’s at the community center on Maple Street this Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll also ask if they still need hands-on repair help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — that’s exactly what I needed. If they still need help, please let me know, and I’ll bring tape, screwdrivers, and any spare bulbs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll check if they still need hands-on repair help and let you know. Appreciate you bringing supplies!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — it’s the neighborhood repair drive for the broken fence and porch lights. Saturday morning at the community center works, and I appreciate you bringing whatever tools and small appliances you can find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring what I can and help sort through what’s already fixed versus what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — I’ll make a quick list so we can separate the fixed items from the ones still needing work.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina. It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, so I can help coordinate around the school schedule and just need to know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what still needs doing for Sunday, and what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate you helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, of course — I’m still checking what needs fixing for the repair drive. If I end up needing that wrench or screwdriver, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — just let me know if you need anything else, and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our tools and spare parts now, and I’ll let you know what we’re still missing before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — once you’ve checked, let me know what’s missing and I’ll help round it up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll go through everything and send you the missing list soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can pass along the details and help round up a few more hands if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great — a few more hands would really help. I’m still keeping track of the drop-off spot and the addresses we collect.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll spread the word and ask folks to drop off any addresses they have. Just let me know if the drop-off spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, quick update — the repair drive got moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep passing along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks Tess — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know if you need me to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — I’ll spread the word if anything else changes. Appreciate you being flexible!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’d like to plan ahead, so could you let me know the exact time and drop-off spot once they’re set?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll let you know as soon as the time and drop-off spot are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for the update so I can plan my ride.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. Thanks for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for the update — what’s still needed most right now? If there’s one item that would help right away, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: A few more tool kits and extension cords would help most right away. If you can grab either, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring everyone up to speed at the repair drive and keep the plan moving. If you hear of anything still needed, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—I'll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear. If I catch what’s still most needed, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. What would you like me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Please send me the updated list first, and I’ll help keep things organized. What still needs attention for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the updated list right away. We still need help sorting donations, checking the tool table, and confirming volunteers for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by a couple places on my errands and see what’s still needed for the repair drive. Then I can let you know if anything’s left to cover.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, can you let me know exactly what’s still needed after you check?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’ll check and bring back the exact list of what’s still needed.
